steps.title: Work with your Partner Manager
steps.body: Partners work with their Partner Manager to select and achieve a competency.

steps.title: Package
steps.body: A zip file with the Competency Submission Workbook and all required documentation.

steps.title: Customer confirmation
steps.body: Request written confirmation that permissions and security meet expectations after a custom test group reviews the results.

steps.title: Renewal
steps.body: Validated every 18 months, with written customer documentation from within 3 months before renewal.
